correctness.rationale: A four-type independent-edge decomposition yields the exact bivariate probability generating function for all n and p. Conditioning on the absence of a two-step path to the second hub proves the signed binomial identity and stochastic coupling; the coefficient ratio gives a unique crossing; separated binomial means give the sharp total-variation asymptotic. Differentiating verifies the exact mean, pair covariance and fair-bias variance. The direct directed-BFS checker successfully replayed 710 exact assertions. Hypotheses and fixed-interior-bias restriction are explicit.

value.rationale: The two-hub biclique is the first cyclic complete-bipartite test family, and exact finite cluster-size laws and signed quantitative binomial errors are useful beyond generic qualitative positive association.
